name: nextc-core
description: Development workflow pipelines — clarify, feature-dev, team-feature-dev, bug-fix, cleanup, update-docs, autopilot. Composable skills that chain into each other.

ask_level.title: How much Claude asks
ask_level.description: normal: Claude asks before a heavy process nobody asked for, when a request can be read two ways, and before retrying a failed store upload. less: it does not ask in those cases; it skips the heavy check and says so, picks the sensible reading, retries a diagnosed upload, and saves real product choices for one question. Needs the nextc rules, which this plugin installs (see install_rules).

install_rules.title: Install the nextc rules
install_rules.description: At session start, copy the rules this plugin ships into ~/.claude/rules/nextc-claude (and their references into ~/.claude/nextc-claude-references) and refresh them when the plugin updates. In the session that writes them Claude is asked to read them first; from the next session they load by themselves. A file you edited is left alone (delete it to get the shipped one back), and so is a folder linked to a checkout. The references always go under ~/.claude, also when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR moves the rules. Off: install them yourself with setup-rules.sh.
